title: Zerodha Portfolio Position
description: A holding (long-term DEMAT) or short-term position synced from Zerodha via Kite Connect v3.

exchange.description: Exchange the instrument is listed on.

isin.description: International Securities Identification Number, where available (equities only).

quantity.description: Total quantity held (realised for holdings; net for positions).

avg_price.description: Average entry price in paise (minor units of INR).

current_price.description: Last traded price in paise (minor units of INR).

close_price.description: Previous close price in paise (minor units of INR).

unrealised_pnl.description: Unrealised profit/loss in paise (minor units of INR). Kite returns this in rupees; the sync job converts.

day_change.description: Day's price change in paise (minor units of INR).

account_type.description: Kite product type: CNC (delivery), MIS (intraday), NRML (overnight F&O).

buy_price.description: Average buy price in paise (positions only).

sell_price.description: Average sell price in paise (positions only).

buy_value.description: Total buy value in paise (positions only).

sell_value.description: Total sell value in paise (positions only).

position_value_minor.description: Computed market value of the position in paise, derived by the sync job as quantity * current_price.

portfolio_weight_pct.description: Computed weight of this position as a percentage of total portfolio value, derived by the sync job.
